info.title: Devin API v2
info.description: Devin API v2 - Enterprise admin APIs for organization management, members, API keys, audit logs, consumption metrics, and sessions.

get.description: Get API keys across organizations in the enterprise with pagination and optional org filter.

post.description: Provision a service API key for an organization in the enterprise.

delete.description: Revoke all API keys in the enterprise.
Revoke a specific API key in the enterprise.

get.description: Generate a list of all the billing cycles for the enterprise until today.

Return daily consumption for the current billing cycle.

**Timezone behavior**: Billing cycles use midnight PST (Pacific Standard Time)
as the day boundary, which corresponds to 08:00:00 UTC. To match the consumption
data shown in the Devin dashboard, pass timestamps with this timezone offset
(e.g., `2025-12-05T08:00:00Z` for December 5, 2025 PST).

Return daily consumption for a specific user. Defaults to current billing cycle.

**Timezone behavior**: Billing cycles use midnight PST (Pacific Standard Time)
as the day boundary, which corresponds to 08:00:00 UTC. To match the consumption
data shown in the Devin dashboard, pass timestamps with this timezone offset
(e.g., `2025-12-05T08:00:00Z` for December 5, 2025 PST).
List paginated members in this enterprise

post.description: Invite multiple users to the enterprise by email (bulk invite, max 100 users)

patch.description:
Update account roles for users available to the user's enterprise.
Takes a list of user_ids and a role_id.

delete.description: Remove a user from an organization

get.description: Get details for a specific member in this enterprise

post.description: Create a new organization in this enterprise

get.description: List paginated organizations in this enterprise

delete.description: Delete an organization from this enterprise

get.description: Get details for a specific organization in this enterprise

patch.description: Update an organization's ACU limit and/or display name

get.description: Get a specific enterprise playbook by ID.

List all roles that are available to the user's enterprise.
For each role, include the role_id, role_name, and role_type.
List sessions with detailed information for enterprise.
Get a single session by ID with detailed info.

emails.description: List of email addresses to invite (max 100)

BearerAuth.description: API Key authentication. Use Personal API Key (apk_user_*) or Service API Key (apk_*) for v1/v2. Use Service User credential (cog_*) for v3.
